title: Board Game Night, Aries Edition
old_caption:
2016 Aries flipped the board. 2026 Aries took a deep breath and said good game.
Still competitive, just a better sport. Who in your group can't lose quietly?

title: Date Night: One Month vs Ten Years
old_caption:
One month in: a cologne cloud, tiny plates and a teddy bigger than the car.
Ten years in: the usual order, a fixed cupboard and the same hand on the walk home.

title: Living Alone: Night One vs Year Ten
old_caption:
Night one alone: every creak was a crisis and dinner was cereal from the box.
Year ten: the pipe has a name and the neighbour still brings cookies. What did your first night alone feel like?

title: Aries' holidays
old_caption: Aries in 2016 opened every gift by 5 AM, including the ones with someone else's name on them. Aries in 2026 sits on its hands and lets you go first. Growth looks like vibrating quietly.

title: Taurus' holidays
old_caption: 2016 Taurus guarded the cookie plate under a blanket. 2026 Taurus bakes a whole tray for your family first, and one spare, obviously. Who in your life is a cookie hoarder turned cookie sharer?

title: Gemini's holidays
old_caption: Three parties, one night, zero real conversations. Then Gemini found one couch and one person and the clock just kept jumping. Are you a three-parties person or a five-more-minutes person?

title: Cancer's holidays
old_caption: Cancer cooked for twenty and nobody asked how Cancer was doing. This year someone took the spoon and asked first. Tag the friend who always hosts and never sits down.

title: Leo's holidays
old_caption: 2016 Leo spelled its own name in lights and blinded the whole street. 2026 Leo turns the spotlight around and points it at you. Still bright, just better aimed.

title: Virgo's holidays
old_caption: Virgo spent the 2016 party at the sink and missed the gift swap entirely. This year the dishes stayed dirty and Virgo stayed on the couch. Which one are you at a party: dancer or dish duty?

title: Libra's holidays
old_caption: Libra couldn't pick a gift in 2016, so it bought all six and buried its date in boxes. In 2026 it just asked what would make them feel loved, and wrote the answer down. Revolutionary.
